title: Changing a task's evaluation-mode pin after a failing evaluation retires it without carrying the failure
outcome: Changing a task's evaluation-mode pin after a failing evaluation retires it without carrying the failure
acceptance: A pin change with no blocking evaluation, or by a planner, behaves as the decided rule says, and the acceptance-evaluation doc states it

A test shows that after a blocking evaluation, a change to the item's evaluation-mode pin (clear, or pin another mode) by the run's executor no longer lets a later evaluation in the newly allowed mode complete the task without the failure being carried or the change refused
